title: Schleuser sollen Sprachzertifikate gefälscht haben – Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse vollstreckt

extraction.summaryEn: Police executed search warrants at five residences and one business premises in Wedding, Kreuzberg and Lichterfelde over suspected forged language certificates and residence confirmations used for people-smuggling. Four suspects were found during the searches, and no arrests were made.
